title: Warmly Spiced Dutch Apricot Flatbread
description: A traditional Dutch flatbread filled with dried apricots and warm spices, perfect for a snack or dessert. This recipe features a long-fermentation dough and is onion and garlic free.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, salt, sugar, and spices in a large mixing bowl.
Add warm milk, melted butter, and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large rectangle.
Brush the dough with beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Spread chopped dried apricots evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough over the apricots to form a crust.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the flatbread in a preheated oven at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
